wrong_controls.details: All citations are tagged [VERIFY_PRECOMMIT] reflecting training-cutoff (Jan 2026) knowledge.  Curator must verify each T2 value against current literature before promoting from PROVISIONAL_DRAFT to SEALED.

wrong_controls.name: WC2_gate_rates_are_engineering_inputs_not_SAM_predictions
wrong_controls.details: omega_gate is a parameter of the experiment (typical gate rate per platform), not a SAM-internal quantity.  Different measurement protocols (raw, DD, echo-corrected) can yield different effective rates; we use typical operating rates as documented in the dataset.

wrong_controls.name: WC3_CR063a_v1_0_NOT_modified
wrong_controls.details: CR063a v1.0 stays sealed at the horizon (A=1) reading.  CR064a refines it via the A_0 operating point correction, producing v1.1.  v1.0 is preserved for the audit record.

wrong_controls.name: WC4_at_the_limit_classification_is_band_NOT_point
wrong_controls.details: Ratio 0.5-2.0 is classified AT_THE_LIMIT to allow for experimental uncertainty and gate-rate definition variability.  This is a band, not a point.  A point match would require precise gate-rate measurement which is not feasible from literature alone.

wrong_controls.name: WC5_falsifier_threshold_10x_not_1_1x
wrong_controls.details: Falsifier requires T2_observed > 10 * T2_grav at the same omega_gate.  A factor of 10 above the predicted floor is much larger than published-value uncertainty, ensuring the falsifier is unambiguous when triggered.

wrong_controls.name: WC6_inconclusive_outcomes_NOT_evasion
wrong_controls.details: If future measurements show T2 between T2_grav and 10x T2_grav at the same gate rate, this is a SOFT TENSION not yet a violation.  Multiple such measurements would prompt v1.2 refinement.  This is documented as expected behavior, not evasion.

wrong_controls.name: WC7_A_0_calibration_traceable_to_SAM_glossary
wrong_controls.details: A_0 = 1/(pi*R) is the SAM accumulation floor (SAMs_TOE v0.2 glossary G:A0). The correction T2_grav_at_A_0 = T2_grav_at_horizon * (1/A_0) follows from interpreting the gravitational coupling as scaling linearly with A; at A_0 instead of A=1, the coupling is reduced by factor A_0.
